Also independently inspected timed clock regions for all ten IDs and verified each corrected worker/wrapper boundary against its exact file. Other nine full source/arithmetic inspections are Luna's with primary claims and provenance checks.

Version3 fixes exact timed call chains and exact per-file worker/wrapper boundaries; independent sample has worker882-1033 and wrapper1200-1258. No finding changed.
